chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Azdi from Malik ibn Anas. He said: al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:

I am astonished at one who is stingy in this world when it presents itself to him, or is stingy in it when it turns away from him. Spending when it presents itself will not harm him, and withholding when it turns away will not benefit him.

key_terms.الإمساك: Withholding, retention -- the opposite of generosity
key_terms.يبخل: To be stingy, miserly -- withholding what one has

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about stinginess and generosity?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted via Malik ibn Anas, expresses amazement at two types of people: those who are stingy when worldly blessings come to them, and those who hoard when the world turns away. He teaches that generosity during prosperity causes no harm, while hoarding during adversity brings no benefit -- a profound lesson on detachment from the transient world.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from his father from Abi Ahmad Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Azdi from Malik b. Anas. He said: al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:

I am astonished at one who is stingy in this world when it presents itself to him or is stingy in it when it turns away from him. Spending when it presents itself will not harm him and withholding when it turns away will not benefit him.
